column1: Term: Species
column2: Definition: A group of individual organisms with fundamental similarities, distinguishable from other closely related groups by distinct morphological differences.

column1: Term: Genus
column2: Definition: A group of related species which has more characters in common in comparison to species of other genera.

column1: The lion (*Panthera leo*) and the tiger (*Panthera tigris*) belong to the same _____.
Term: Family
column2: Definition: A group of related genera with still fewer similarities as compared to genus and species.

column2: Definition: An assemblage of families which exhibit a few similar characters.

column1: The animal families Felidae (cats) and Canidae (dogs) are both included in which order?
Term: Class
column2: Definition: A category that includes related orders.

column1: Order Primata (monkey, gorilla) and Order Carnivora (tiger, dog) are both placed in which class?

column2: Definition: A category comprising classes with shared features, such as the presence of a notochord in animals.
